ResearchProjectDef.label: auto weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Receive advanced schemata data, containing instructions on how to forge advanced Skitarii weaponry.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ceramite production
ResearchProjectDef.description: Produce advanced ceramic composites from stone blocks and other materials.

ResearchProjectDef.label: radium volleys
ResearchProjectDef.description: Receive sacred rites of radium armament construction, weapons capable of unleashing volatile radium volleys that annihilate foes through sanctified radioactive force.

ResearchProjectDef.label: arc permacapacitors
ResearchProjectDef.description: Be vested with the consecrated rites of arc permacapacitors, channelling bound machine-spirits to unleash searing arcs of sanctified energy that scour flesh, armour, and circuitry alike.

ResearchProjectDef.label: phosphor munitions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Receive sacred rites of phosphor manipulation, allowing machine-spirits to project blinding burning phosphor discharges.

ResearchProjectDef.label: plasma induction
ResearchProjectDef.description: Be granted the consecrated rites of plasma induction, allowing the containment and manipulation of extreme thermal energies for use in weapon systems, power generation, and advanced industrial applications.

ResearchProjectDef.label: matter destabilization
ResearchProjectDef.description: Be vested with rites of matter destabilization, capable of unmaking materials and living tissue.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Cult Mechanicus
ResearchProjectDef.description: Be vested with the rites of the Machine Cult, authorizing the construction of Mechanicus forge altars capable of producing the majority of faction armaments, apparel, and sanctioned equipment.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Many pieces of Mechanicus apparel and armour require hyperweave, a tough and hard-to-acquire fabric. Hyperweave can be found through quests, trade, and exploration, but can also be refined by scrapping apparel and armour at the Mechanicus forge altar.\n\nRecycling low-durability and low-quality clothing for hyperweave is a great way to provide materials for your own production.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Tech-Guard
ResearchProjectDef.description: Be granted basic Skitarii fabrication data sheets, containing the data for the making of special equipment, including implants, weapons and apparel.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Tech-Guard advanced arsenal
ResearchProjectDef.description: Receive advanced schemata data, containing instruction on how to forge advanced Skitarii weaponry and implants.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Maniple tactics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Be instructed in the advanced organization and equipment of the Tech-Guard, including the highest-ranking officers necessary for the prosecution of war in the name of the Omnissiah.

ResearchProjectDef.label: True Flesh
ResearchProjectDef.description: Be granted the secrets of true flesh manipulation, allowing for the creation of enhanced augmetic components for the glorification of the Machine God.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: The rank system of Mechanicus techpriests and their armed forces, the skitarii, is largely tied to artificial implants or augmetics. Augmetics can be manufactured at the Mechanicus augmetic microforge, and many ranks require a certain number of augmetic implants for a priest or skitarius to advance to the next rank.\n\nSome ranks ask for specific implants. For instance, the noospheric cortex is required by most techpriest rank paths at some point, and skitarii require the skitarii leg and skitarii eye lens implants.

ResearchProjectDef.label: holy order vestments
ResearchProjectDef.description: Be granted the right to clothe the ordained tech-clergy in garb appropriate to their particular devotions.
